name: Mathildenhöhe Darmstadt
description: On a hilltop above Darmstadt in west-central Germany, Grand Duke Ernst Ludwig founded an artists' colony in 1897 as a testing ground for new ideas in building and design. Visitors can wander between Jugendstil (Art Nouveau) houses and studios, the tall Wedding Tower, a lily basin and a plane-tree grove. A gilded-domed Russian chapel adds a surprise. Four exhibitions between 1901 and 1914 shaped the site.
